differences: The paper reports that, on average, 14.35 % of trials were excluded; the authors' valid flag marks 12.6 % of the rows as invalid in the deposit.

The paper says the 50 pre-adaptation trials were averaged; the published pre-adaptation amplitudes (experiments 1 and 2) are reproduced from all 100 pre-adaptation trials of each observer. The forward amplitude at the end of adaptation in experiment 1 is 8.75 deg here against 8.65 deg in the paper (last 50 adaptation trials, valid trials); the other three end-of-adaptation means agree within 0.03 deg.

Experiments 4 and 5 appear in the deposit with the vertical array coded as characters 2 to 4 of a five-position array; vertical step sizes in degrees are not given, so step_y_deg is empty for them and pert_value counts array positions.
